entities.summary: Abu Nasr Mansur ibn Moshkan, better simply known as Abu Nasr Moshkan, was a Persian statesman who served as the head of the Ghaznavid chancery from 1011/2 till his death in 1039/40. His nephew, Tahir ibn Ali ibn Moshkan, known by his title of Thiqat al-Mulk, served as the vizier of Sultan Mas'ud III.
